missing_points: Type 1 (Auto-Reset/Run) faults can be automatically reset if the fault condition clears; example: F002 Auxiliary Input
Type 2 (Non-Resettable) faults require drive or motor repair or wiring correction before the fault can be cleared; example: F006 Motor Stalled, F070 Power Unit failure
Type 1 faults show in the fault log but may not halt operation if auto-reset is enabled
Type 2 faults always halt the drive and require manual intervention to clear
